+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Generate a replayable butter-on-raisin trajectory for the frozen instance."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_robolab import Session
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+s = Session('butter_above_raisin', instance='/app/instance.json')
+p = s.primitives()
+objs = s.objects()
+print('initial', json.dumps(objs), flush=True)
+print('tcp', s.ee_pose(), 'closing_dir', p['get_finger_closing_dir'](), flush=True)
+for cam in ('egocentric_mirrored_camera', 'over_shoulder_left_camera'):
+    try:
+        Image.fromarray(s.render_frame(cam)).save(OUT / f'initial_{cam}.png')
+    except Exception as e:
+        print('render failed', cam, repr(e), flush=True)
+for name in ('butter', 'raisin_box'):
+    pts = p['get_object_points'](name)
+    print(name, 'mesh points', pts.shape, 'aabb', pts.min(0), pts.max(0), flush=True)
+
+butter = objs['butter']['bounds']
+raisin = objs['raisin_box']['bounds']
+pick_xy = (np.asarray(butter[0][:2]) + np.asarray(butter[1][:2])) / 2
+place_xy = (np.asarray(raisin[0][:2]) + np.asarray(raisin[1][:2])) / 2
+pick_z = float(butter[0][2] + 0.002)
+top_z = float(raisin[1][2])
+q = p['top_down_quat'](0.0)
+print('targets', 'pick', pick_xy, pick_z, 'place', place_xy, 'raisin top', top_z, 'quat', q, flush=True)
+
+s.record_start()
+try:
+    p['move_ee']([pick_xy[0], pick_xy[1], 0.16], q, speed=0.18, max_dq=0.07, tol=0.004, settle=4)
+    p['move_ee']([pick_xy[0], pick_xy[1], pick_z], q, speed=0.07, max_dq=0.035, tol=0.003, settle=3)
+    p['close_gripper'](steps=24)
+    p['hold'](5)
+    print('after close', s.status(), s.objects()['butter'], 'tcp', s.ee_pose()[0], flush=True)
+    p['move_ee']([pick_xy[0], pick_xy[1], 0.17], q, speed=0.12, max_dq=0.06, tol=0.004, settle=8)
+    print('after lift', s.status(), s.objects()['butter'], 'tcp', s.ee_pose()[0], flush=True)
+    if s.episode_done:
+        raise RuntimeError('episode ended during pick')
+    # Carry above the raisin box, then derive the set-down height from the object's measured pose while held.
+    p['move_ee']([place_xy[0], place_xy[1], 0.17], q, speed=0.13, max_dq=0.06, tol=0.004, settle=4)
+    held = s.objects()['butter']['bounds']
+    tcp = s.ee_pose()[0]
+    # A slight penetration target lets the contact solver establish firm support before release.
+    set_z = float(tcp[2] + (top_z - 0.002 - held[0][2]))
+    print('pre-place', s.status(), 'held bounds', held, 'tcp', tcp, 'set tcp z', set_z, flush=True)
+    p['move_ee']([place_xy[0], place_xy[1], set_z], q, speed=0.06, max_dq=0.035, tol=0.0025, settle=8)
+    p['open_gripper'](steps=22)
+    p['hold'](40)
+    print('released', s.status(), s.objects()['butter'], flush=True)
+    if not s.episode_done:
+        p['move_ee']([place_xy[0], place_xy[1], set_z + 0.10], q, speed=0.12, max_dq=0.06, tol=0.004, settle=12)
+        p['hold'](15)
+except Exception as e:
+    print('trajectory exception', repr(e), flush=True)
+actions = s.record_stop()
+print('recorded', actions.shape, 'status', s.status(), flush=True)
+np.save(OUT / 'candidate_actions.npy', actions)
+if s.status()['success']:
+    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / 'trajectory.npz', meta={'strategy': 'top-down side pinch, centered placement', 'steps': len(actions)})
+    print('saved successful trajectory', OUT / 'trajectory.npz', flush=True)
+    # The first replay in this process is the same deterministic replay a fresh verifier sees.
+    replay = s.replay(actions)
+    print('first replay status', replay, flush=True)
+    if replay['success']:
+        s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / 'trajectory.npz', meta={'strategy': 'top-down side pinch, centered placement', 'steps': len(actions), 'first_replay_success': True})
+        try:
+            s.render_video(actions, OUT / 'check.mp4')
+        except Exception as e:
+            print('video failed', repr(e), flush=True)
+else:
+    print('not successful; trajectory not promoted', flush=True)
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
